site.title: Zero-Cost AI Coding
site.tagline: Real tools. Genuinely free. No card, no trial.
site.audience: Developers and indie builders who want real tools at genuine $0 cost — no card, no trial-that-converts
site.description: Single-file, working web tools that solve real developer problems using genuinely free AI, compute, and hosting — every free-tier claim verified against the provider's own current docs.

articles.title: Error Triage
articles.hook: Paste an error, stack trace, or log dump — get classification, root cause, concrete fix steps, and pitfalls, using Groq's free LLM API.
articles.how_free: Groq free tier: 30 req/min, 14,400 req/day, no card — verified at console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits

articles.title: SQL Schema to TypeScript & Migration Generator
articles.hook: Convert PostgreSQL DDL schemas into clean TypeScript interfaces and rollback SQL completely client-side.
articles.how_free: Unlimited client-side execution using standard Browser Web APIs.

articles.title: Commit Forge
articles.hook: Generate conventional commit messages from your git diff using Google Gemini's free API — 1,500 requests/day, no card needed.
articles.how_free: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash free tier: 15 RPM, 1,500 RPD, no credit card — verified at ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits

articles.title: Alt Text Generator
articles.hook: Generate image alt text with an AI model that runs entirely in your browser — no API key, no server, no limit.
articles.how_free: No tier to exceed — Xenova/vit-gpt2-image-captioning runs client-side via Transformers.js/ONNX Runtime Web; only cost is a one-time ~240MB model download cached by the browser.

articles.title: Stack Trace Autopsy
articles.hook: Paste a production stack trace and get the error, the exact user-code line that failed, and ready-to-click Google/Stack Overflow search links — 100% client-side, no API, no limit.
articles.how_free: ∞ runs — pure client-side regex/string parsing in the browser tab, no external service, no key, no rate limit.
